content.title: Refine Homes results with Filters after homepage search
content.intent: Prove the results page exposes Filters and updates results after a filter is applied.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a duplicate because an identical fresh scenario already exists. Techniques: pagination/search-list filtering profile for results refinement; state_flow because the path starts from routed search results. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.

content.title: Refine Homes results with the Map after homepage search
content.intent: Prove the results page exposes the Map and supports location-based refinement for the current search.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a duplicate because an equivalent fresh scenario already exists. Techniques: pagination/search-list profile for collection refinement; state_flow because the path starts from routed search results. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.

content.title: Navigate homepage search and results refinement controls by keyboard
content.intent: Prove the homepage search fields and CTA are reachable in order by Tab and the results-page Filters and Map controls are keyboard-accessible with visible focus indication.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a narrower duplicate because a fresh keyboard-accessibility scenario already covers the required results-page controls, even though it also spans homepage focus order. Techniques: a11y for keyboard reachability and visible focus state; state_flow because the path spans homepage routing into results-page refinement. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.

judgements.rationale: [applicability] Did not mint a negative scenario because the PRD states successful refinement and accessibility behavior but gives no invalid-filter, invalid-map, or failure-handling promise for this use-case.
[applicability] Did not mint a boundary scenario because this use-case contains no source-defined numeric ranges, length limits, or ordered thresholds for Filters or Map interactions.
[applicability] Did not mint a security scenario because the flow is for a guest actor on public search results and the corpus defines no auth or permission gate.
[applicability] Did not mint a performance scenario because the PRD defines no latency or performance threshold for applying filters or interacting with the map.

[applicability] Did not mint an i18n scenario because the localization text in the PRD is limited to the homepage search field labels and Search CTA, not the Filters or Map refinement controls of this use-case.
